_comment: Copy to config.json (chmod 600) and fill in. This file is the ONLY place secrets live. Pass it with --config <path> or ALIRAN_MCP_CONFIG. Give each service an explicit https `url` (a Caddy TLS endpoint) OR omit `url` and its loopback API (:3210 panel / :3310 broadcaster / :3330 reseller / :3320 library) is reached over an SSH local-forward tunnel opened with the ssh key below. `user`/`pass` for panel & broadcaster are their DASHBOARD admin logins (created by `add-admin`, or by `server_install`).
_comment_optional_services: Running the reseller panel (S38/S45) or the VOD library too? Add their blocks and the reseller_*/library_* tool groups light up — same shape as panel/broadcaster: "reseller": { "user": "<root admin principal>", "pass": "..." } and "library": { "user": "<library admin>", "pass": "..." } (omit `url` to tunnel to :3330 / :3320). The reseller login should be the ROOT admin principal — the operator-oversight identity (principals, credit mints, ledger); reseller daily driving stays in the resellers' own panel.
_comment_multi_host: More than one box (repeater appliances, scale-out broadcasters)? Name them inside ssh: "ssh": { "host": "<default box>", "user": "root", "keyPath": "...", "hosts": { "edge-1": { "host": "203.0.113.20", "user": "root", "keyPath": "~/.ssh/aliran_deploy_ed25519", "repoDir": "/opt/aliran" } } }. Every server_* tool, repeater_status and panel_add_publisher then take host:"edge-1" (omitted = the default box). Per-entry keyPath/port/repoDir are optional. A hosts-only shape works too: "hosts" plus "default": "<name>" and no top-level host.
